title: Add JSON Schema structured_output support: response_format, schema validation, strict mode
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add first-class support for structured output using JSON Schema across the API (response_format param), the OpenAI-compat layer, and server-side validation so customers can reliably parse model output. This implements schema-aware validation, helpful error messages, and an optional strict mode that enforces exact schema compliance (useful for tool/function-calling workflows). Key behaviors: (1) New response_format parameter accepts 'json_schema' and a schema payload; (2) Runtime validates response tokens against the provided JSON Schema with best-effort recovery for streaming responses; (3) Strict mode causes immediate schema-validation failure if final output does not match; non-strict mode attempts to coerce/repair common issues and returns warnings in the response metadata; (4) OpenAI-compat adapter accepts the same fields (response_format, strict) for backward-compatible SDK integration. Changes include server-side validation hooks, a lightweight jsonschema validator added to the runtime deps, clearer error codes (ERR_SCHEMA_VALIDATION, ERR_SCHEMA_STREAM_INCOMPLETE), and detailed user-facing error messages that include validation path and expected types. Rollout plan: behind a feature flag (structured_output_json_schema) initially for hosted API, enableable for Dedicated/Private via config. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged when response_format omitted. Checklist: - [x] API param parsing and validation - [x] Runtime schema validator + streaming integration - [x] OpenAI-compat adapter updated - [x] Unit and integration tests for strict/non-strict paths - [x] Docs and example schemas in redwood-docs - [x] E2E test in perf-canary for streaming stability Implementation notes: see commits and files_changed for specifics.
commits: feat(api): add response_format param and parsing + validation hook
feat(runtime): integrate jsonschema validator with streaming collector and final validation pass
feat(compat): support response_format/strict in openai-compat adapter
test: add unit tests for schema validation, repair heuristics, and strict mode errors
docs: api reference and examples for structured_output/json_schema
changed_files: redwood/redwood-api/src/handlers/response_format.rs - add response_format parsing and validation entrypoint
redwood/rust-runtime/src/streaming/schema_validator.rs - streaming-aware jsonschema validator and repair heuristics
redwood/openai-compat/src/adapter.rs - pass through response_format and strict to runtime
perf-canary/scripts/e2e_structured_output_test.py - new E2E test for streaming stability
redwood/CHANGELOG.md - note for structured output feature
review_comments: Omar Ruiz: Overall +1. A few notes: 1) Please make sure streaming partials are validated incrementally to avoid holding VRAM for long sequences; 2) Can we include an opt-out header for legacy clients to avoid extra CPU in Dedicated?
Lina Becker: The repair heuristics look handy but we should be explicit about when they run and surface that via response metadata. Suggest adding a 'validation_warnings' array to response metadata.
Ethan Ross: Small style nits on error codes and tests; also call out performance cost in the docs for high-throughput endpoints. Consider a sampling mode for Dedicated to reduce overhead.
author_replies: Maya Patel: Thanks for the review. Addressed incremental validation in runtime (streaming validator yields partial validation results and times out after heuristics). Added 'X-Redwood-Validation-Opt-Out' header support for Dedicated/Private and documented it. Added validation_warnings array to response metadata and included an opt-in sampling_mode option under Dedicated in helm values.
Maya Patel: Updated tests to include performance regression guardrails and added detailed examples to docs showing strict vs non-strict output.
ci_summary: CI: 1/1 pipeline passed after fixing test flakiness in sdk-python. Integration tests (structured output e2e) ran in perf-canary and passed in baseline environment. Lint and type checks passed.
merge_summary: Squash-merged after approvals from Omar and Lina. All CI checks green. Feature behind flag 'structured_output_json_schema' and rollout notes added to CHANGELOG and docs.
release_notes: Added structured output support via JSON Schema. New 'response_format=json_schema' and 'strict' flag allow schema-validated model responses. Default behavior unchanged. Feature gated; see docs for examples and migration steps.
examples: Invalid response (strict): returns 400 + error body with code ERR_SCHEMA_VALIDATION and details: path '/score', expected 'number', got 'string'
Non-strict response: service returns best-effort repaired object, plus response.metadata.validation_warnings = ['/score: coerced string to number']
observability_changes: Added metrics: structured_output.validation.duration_ms, structured_output.validation.errors.count, structured_output.validation.warnings.count; tracing spans: structured_output.validation and structured_output.repair_heuristic; logs include validation path and pseudo-hash of schema to avoid PII.
performance_notes: Observed ~8-12% CPU increase for strict validation on 1k token responses in baseline tests; added sampling_mode and feature flag to mitigate. perf-canary indicates negligible latency impact for short responses. Recommend enabling on lower-throughput endpoints first.
migration_guide: 1) Add response_format JSON on calls that require structured output. 2) Test in non-strict mode to see repair heuristics and warnings. 3) Flip strict mode when clients are ready and schema coverage is complete. 4) For Dedicated/Private, enable structured_output_json_schema flag in helm values and consider sampling_mode to limit CPU use.
notes: Drafted follow-up work: support for OpenAPI v3 schemas (ENG-9120), richer repair heuristics, user-configurable repair policy, and SDK convenience helpers to convert TypeScript/Pydantic types to JSON Schema.
incident_related: No incident caused this PR. Work was requested after customer feedback (SUP-1321) about unreliable tool-calling outputs in production.
tests_added: Unit tests in rust-runtime for streaming validator; integration tests in perf-canary; sdk-python and sdk-typescript integration tests; new test vectors for strict/non-strict cases.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag controlled. To enable globally on Dedicated: set structured_output_json_schema.enabled=true in helm values and optionally set structured_output_json_schema.sampling_mode.percent=10 for gradual rollout.
permissions: No new scope required for API keys. Validation metadata exposed in response.metadata for callers; make sure customers are aware of additional metadata size in high-throughput apps.
